title: On a PDE model for Learning in Stochastic Market Entry Games
summary: We study a continuum model for stochastic reinforcement learning in repeated market entry games. Starting from a discrete-time microscopic learning rule, we derive a Fokker--Planck-type equation for the distribution of agents' propensities and, using a kinetic closure, obtain a nonlinear one-particle equation of a mean-field type. For the resulting Cauchy problem, we prove existence and uniqueness of solutions and analyze their long-time behavior.
